intro: Chad has about 20 million people from over 200 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: French and Arabic are official. Muslims live mostly in the north and Christians in the south. Chad hosts over a million refugees from Sudan.

chapters.title: N'Djamena
text: N'Djamena, the capital, lies where the Chari and Logone rivers meet.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone forced to flee their country.
